places.name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
places.description: The UAE's largest mosque with 82 domes, white marble courtyards and the world's largest hand-knotted carpet. Free entry; book an e-pass on the official site before visiting.

places.name: Aljada
places.description: Sharjah's new family destination with the Zaha Hadid-designed Madar complex, play areas, restaurants and evening events. Free entry and free parking.

places.name: Al Montazah Parks
places.description: Amusement park and Pearls Kingdom waterpark on an island in Khalid Lagoon, opposite the Central Souk, with rides, go-karts and picnic areas.

places.name: Sharjah Mosque
places.description: Sharjah's largest mosque, opened in 2019, with Ottoman-inspired domes and intricate calligraphy.

places.name: Central Souk (Blue Souk)
places.description: Iconic blue-tiled souk with 600+ shops selling gold, Persian carpets and handicrafts on Khalid Lagoon.

places.name: Al Sawan Camel Race Track
places.hours_text: Races early on Friday mornings in the cooler months, from about 6:30 am
places.description: 10 km sand camel race track in the Digdaga area. Winter races start early on Friday mornings with around 100 camels.

places.name: Al Jazirah Aviation Club
places.description: Scenic flights over the red dunes of Ras Al Khaimah in a two-seater plane or gyrocopter, plus introductory flying lessons.

places.name: Mangrove kayaking (Al Qawasim Corniche)
places.description: Guided kayak and paddleboard tours through Ras Al Khaimah's mangroves, starting from Al Qawasim Corniche; flamingos in winter.

places.name: Kuwaiti Souq
places.description: Traditional souq in Ras Al Khaimah's old town for textiles, spices, perfumes and souvenirs.

places.name: Al Ain Camel Market
places.description: Bustling traditional camel market about 15 km from downtown Al Ain; best in the morning when trading is on.

places.name: Jebel Hafit
places.description: Abu Dhabi's highest peak (1,249 m), reached by an 11.7 km mountain road with sunrise and sunset views over Al Ain.
